```{r date_setup}
start_date <- ymd("2017-12-01")
end_date   <- ymd("2025-12-31")
```

```{r load fred}
getSymbols(c("DCOILWTICO", "SP500", "VIXCLS"), src = "FRED", auto.assign = TRUE)

us_daily <- merge(DCOILWTICO, SP500, VIXCLS)
us_daily <- us_daily[paste0(start_date, "/", end_date)]

df_us_daily <- tibble(
  date  = as.Date(index(us_daily)),
  WTI   = as.numeric(us_daily$DCOILWTICO),
  SP500 = as.numeric(us_daily$SP500),
  VIX   = as.numeric(us_daily$VIXCLS)
)
```
```{r load lseg-ph-finmkt}
# LSEG price-history exports store dates as Excel serial numbers
excel_date <- function(x) as.Date(as.numeric(x), origin = "1899-12-30")

ph_10y_raw <- read_excel("PH_10Y_GS_YIELD_1825.xlsx", skip = 18)
ph_10y_daily <- ph_10y_raw %>%
  select(date = Date, PH_10Y_GS_Yield = `Yield to Maturity`) %>%
  mutate(
    date = excel_date(date),
    PH_10Y_GS_Yield = as.numeric(PH_10Y_GS_Yield)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date) & between(date, start_date, end_date))

psei_raw <- read_excel("PSEI_1825.xlsx", skip = 32)
psei_daily <- psei_raw %>%
  select(date = `Exchange Date`, PSEI = Close) %>%
  mutate(
    date = excel_date(date),
    PSEI =as.numeric(PSEI)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date) & between(date, start_date, end_date))

usdphp_raw <- read_excel("USDPHP_1825.xlsx", skip = 28)
usdphp_daily <- usdphp_raw %>%
  select(date = `Exchange Date`, USD_PHP = `Mid Price`) %>%
  mutate(
    date = excel_date(date),
    USD_PHP =as.numeric(USD_PHP)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date) & between(date, start_date, end_date))

rrp_raw <- read_excel("PH_RRP_1725.xlsx", skip = 2,
                      col_names = c("date", "BSP_RRP_Rate"))
rrp_1725 <- rrp_raw %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    BSP_RRP_Rate = as.numeric(BSP_RRP_Rate)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date) & date <= end_date) %>%
  arrange(date)
```

```{r load lseg-ph-macroecon}
read_ph_macro <- function(filepath, var_name) {
  read_excel(filepath, skip = 1) %>%
    set_names(c("date", var_name)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(date) & !is.na(.data[[var_name]])) %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.Date(date),
      # Truncate to first of the month for clean relational joins
      year_month = floor_date(date, unit = "month"),
      !!var_name := as.numeric(.data[[var_name]])
    ) %>%
    select(year_month, all_of(var_name))
}

cpi_monthly  <- read_ph_macro("PH_CPI_YY_1626.xlsx", "PH_CPI")
m3_monthly   <- read_ph_macro("PH_M3_YY_1626.xlsx", "PH_M3")
mfg_monthly  <- read_ph_macro("PH_Manufacturing_Production_YY_1626.xlsx", "PH_Manufacturing_Production")
```

```{r consolidate main-dataframe}
daily_financials <- psei_daily %>%
  full_join(usdphp_daily, by = "date") %>%
  full_join(ph_10y_daily, by = "date") %>%
  full_join(df_us_daily, by = "date") %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  # forward fill missing based on last previous day (VIX is averaged, so not filled)
  tidyr::fill(PSEI, USD_PHP, PH_10Y_GS_Yield, WTI, SP500, .direction = "down")

# month-end value; NA (not size 0) when a month has no observations yet
last_valid <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else x[length(x)]
}

financial_monthly <- daily_financials %>%
  mutate(year_month = floor_date(date, unit = "month")) %>%
  group_by(year_month) %>%
  summarise(
    PSEI            = last_valid(PSEI),
    USD_PHP         = last_valid(USD_PHP),
    PH_10Y_GS_Yield = last_valid(PH_10Y_GS_Yield),
    WTI             = last_valid(WTI),
    SP500           = last_valid(SP500),
    VIX             = if (all(is.na(VIX))) NA_real_ else mean(VIX, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups         = "drop"
  )

# one row per month, Dec 2017 - Dec 2025 (Dec 2017 is only the base month for
# the returns / first differences and is dropped below)
month_spine <- tibble(
  year_month = seq(floor_date(start_date, "month"),
                   floor_date(end_date, "month"), by = "month")
)

# BSP RRP rate in force at each month-end (rate changes on meeting dates)
rrp_monthly <- month_spine %>%
  mutate(
    month_end    = ceiling_date(year_month, "month") - days(1),
    rrp_idx      = findInterval(as.numeric(month_end), as.numeric(rrp_1725$date)),
    BSP_RRP_Rate = if_else(rrp_idx == 0, NA_real_,
                           rrp_1725$BSP_RRP_Rate[pmax(rrp_idx, 1)])
  ) %>%
  select(year_month, BSP_RRP_Rate)

df_econometrics <- month_spine %>%
  left_join(financial_monthly, by = "year_month") %>%
  left_join(rrp_monthly,       by = "year_month") %>%
  left_join(cpi_monthly,       by = "year_month") %>%
  left_join(m3_monthly,        by = "year_month") %>%
  left_join(mfg_monthly,       by = "year_month") %>%
  arrange(year_month) %>%
  mutate(
    # monthly log returns / log changes (month-end levels)
    PSEI    = log(PSEI)    - log(lag(PSEI)),
    SP500   = log(SP500)   - log(lag(SP500)),
    USD_PHP = log(USD_PHP) - log(lag(USD_PHP)),
    WTI     = log(WTI)     - log(lag(WTI)),
    # month-end first differences
    BSP_RRP_Rate    = BSP_RRP_Rate    - lag(BSP_RRP_Rate),
    PH_10Y_GS_Yield = PH_10Y_GS_Yield - lag(PH_10Y_GS_Yield)
    # PH_CPI, PH_M3, PH_Manufacturing_Production are already YoY % in the LSEG
    # files; VIX is already the monthly average
  ) %>%
  # drop 2017
  filter(year(year_month) >= 2018)

glimpse(df_econometrics)
head(df_econometrics)
```
```{r data-quality-checks}
# 1. structure: row count, month coverage, duplicates, gaps
expected_months <- seq(ymd("2018-01-01"), ymd("2025-12-01"), by = "month")
tibble(
  rows               = nrow(df_econometrics),
  expected_rows      = length(expected_months),
  first_month        = min(df_econometrics$year_month),
  last_month         = max(df_econometrics$year_month),
  duplicate_months   = sum(duplicated(df_econometrics$year_month)),
  missing_months     = sum(!expected_months %in% df_econometrics$year_month),
  is_sorted          = !is.unsorted(df_econometrics$year_month)
) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "check", values_to = "value",
               values_transform = as.character) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Structure and month coverage")

# 2. data types, missing, non-finite, constant columns
df_econometrics %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), list(
    type     = ~ class(.x)[1],
    n_na     = ~ sum(is.na(.x)),
    pct_na   = ~ round(100 * mean(is.na(.x)), 1),
    n_inf    = ~ if (is.numeric(.x)) sum(is.infinite(.x)) else 0L,
    n_unique = ~ n_distinct(.x)
  ), .names = "{.col}__{.fn}")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("variable", ".value"),
               names_sep = "__") %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Data types, missing observations and non-finite values")

# 3. which months have missing values
df_econometrics %>%
  filter(if_any(-year_month, is.na)) %>%
  transmute(year_month,
            missing_vars = pmap_chr(pick(-year_month),
              function(...) paste(names(c(...))[is.na(c(...))], collapse = ", "))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Months with missing values")

# 4. distribution / outlier screen (|z| > 3)
df_econometrics %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable") %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    min        = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median     = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean       = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max        = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd         = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_outliers = sum(abs(value - mean) / sd > 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Ranges and outliers (|z| > 3)")

# 5. plausibility rules
tibble(
  check = c("VIX <= 0", "PH_CPI outside [-5, 25]%", "PH_M3 outside [-20, 40]%",
            "PH_Manufacturing_Production outside [-50, 100]%",
            "|monthly log return| > 0.25 (PSEI, SP500, USD_PHP, WTI)"),
  n_flagged = c(
    sum(df_econometrics$VIX <= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(!between(df_econometrics$PH_CPI, -5, 25), na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(!between(df_econometrics$PH_M3, -20, 40), na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(!between(df_econometrics$PH_Manufacturing_Production, -50, 100), na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(abs(as.matrix(df_econometrics[c("PSEI", "SP500", "USD_PHP", "WTI")])) > 0.25,
        na.rm = TRUE)
  )
) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Plausibility checks")
```

```{r descriptive-stats}
skewness <- function(x) mean((x - mean(x))^3) / mean((x - mean(x))^2)^1.5
excess_kurtosis <- function(x) mean((x - mean(x))^4) / mean((x - mean(x))^2)^2 - 3

vars <- setdiff(names(df_econometrics), "year_month")

num_long <- df_econometrics %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(vars), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = vars))

desc_stats <- num_long %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    n        = n(),
    mean     = mean(value),
    median   = median(value),
    min      = min(value),
    max      = max(value),
    range    = max - min,
    sd       = sd(value),
    skewness = skewness(value),
    ex_kurtosis = excess_kurtosis(value),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

desc_stats %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Descriptive statistics (excess kurtosis; normal = 0)")

# panel labels carrying the statistics
panel_labels <- desc_stats %>%
  transmute(
    variable,
    lab_center = sprintf("%s\nmean = %.3f | median = %.3f", variable, mean, median),
    lab_spread = sprintf("%s\nrange = %.3f | sd = %.3f", variable, range, sd),
    lab_shape  = sprintf("%s\nskew = %.2f | ex. kurtosis = %.2f", variable, skewness, ex_kurtosis)
  ) %>%
  # keep facets in dataset column order rather than alphabetical
  mutate(across(starts_with("lab_"), ~ factor(.x, levels = .x)))

plot_data <- num_long %>% left_join(panel_labels, by = "variable")
stat_lines <- desc_stats %>%
  select(variable, mean, median) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(mean, median), names_to = "stat", values_to = "x") %>%
  left_join(panel_labels, by = "variable")
```

```{r descriptive-histograms, fig.height=14}
# histogram per variable with mean and median
ggplot(plot_data, aes(value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, fill = "grey70", colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(data = stat_lines, aes(xintercept = x, colour = stat, linetype = stat),
             linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ lab_center, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(mean = "firebrick", median = "steelblue"), name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(mean = "solid", median = "dashed"), name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Histograms with mean and median", x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r descriptive-distributions, fig.height=14}
# density per variable vs a normal curve with the same mean / sd (skewness, kurtosis)
normal_curves <- desc_stats %>%
  select(variable, mean, sd) %>%
  mutate(x = map2(mean, sd, ~ seq(.x - 4 * .y, .x + 4 * .y, length.out = 200))) %>%
  unnest(x) %>%
  mutate(density = dnorm(x, mean, sd)) %>%
  left_join(panel_labels, by = "variable")

ggplot(plot_data, aes(value)) +
  geom_density(aes(colour = "Observed"), fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = normal_curves, aes(x, density, colour = "Normal"),
            linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ lab_shape, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Observed = "steelblue", Normal = "firebrick"), name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Distributions vs normal (skewness and excess kurtosis)", x = NULL, y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r descriptive-boxplots, fig.height=14}
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = "", y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "grey85", outlier.colour = "firebrick", outlier.size = 1.8) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, fill = "white", size = 2) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ lab_spread, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  labs(title = "Boxplots (diamond = mean, red = outliers)", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), axis.text.y = element_blank())
```

```{r correlation-matrix, fig.height=8}
# pairwise-complete Pearson correlations (January 2018 is NA for 3 variables)
cor_matrix <- df_econometrics %>%
  select(all_of(vars)) %>%
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

round(cor_matrix, 3) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Pearson correlation matrix")

# correlation heatmap; blank cells are not significant at the 5% level
cor_pvalues <- outer(vars, vars, Vectorize(function(a, b) {
  if (a == b) return(0)
  cor.test(df_econometrics[[a]], df_econometrics[[b]])$p.value
}))
dimnames(cor_pvalues) <- dimnames(cor_matrix)

corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", type = "upper", order = "original",
         addCoef.col = "black", number.cex = 0.7, tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45,
         p.mat = cor_pvalues, sig.level = 0.05, insig = "blank",
         diag = FALSE, mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0),
         title = "Correlation matrix (blank = not significant at 5%)")

# strongest pairs, and PSEI against each candidate regressor
cor_pairs <- as_tibble(cor_matrix, rownames = "var1") %>%
  pivot_longer(-var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "r") %>%
  filter(match(var1, vars) < match(var2, vars)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(r)))

cor_pairs %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(r = round(r, 3)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Ten strongest pairwise correlations")

cor_pairs %>%
  filter(var1 == "PSEI") %>%
  mutate(r = round(r, 3)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Correlation of PSEI with each candidate regressor")

# multicollinearity screen among regressors
cor_pairs %>%
  filter(var1 != "PSEI", abs(r) > 0.7) %>%
  mutate(r = round(r, 3)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Regressor pairs with |r| > 0.7 (multicollinearity flag)")
```
